description: Set out for every ride in style with Brompton's stunning A Line model. With a brilliant white finish that represents the pure enjoyment experienced from riding such an ergonomic bike, you can unlock a world of opportunity at the push of a pedal. This sensational folding bike offers a unique ride thanks to the lightweight, hand-crafted frame which improves speed and agility. Also including 3-hub gears and strong brakes, you can glide, race, and roll at your desired pace. The A Line gear technology is unique as it lets you shift down when stationary making for a much smoother start to any journey. Whether you are exploring a characterful city or a rugged outdoor area, a joyful ride is guaranteed. The stunning white silhouette is enhanced by rich steel and soulful black accents making for a stylish bike. Furthermore, the mid-handlebar, which offers improved posture for the rider, makes for an even more comfortable riding experience. All of this is perfectly wrapped up in a light and compact frame, which weighs just 11.5kgs. This makes it simple to get around and carry your bike when converted to its folded design which is the same size as a small suitcase. Simple to carry, ease, easy to store, and a pleasure to ride; this bike has it all.With an upright position guaranteed, you can ride with your body relaxed and mind close to the clouds for a carefree experience.. Brompton offers more than just a bike; it provides a new way of living.
